trace.question: What is the disease patient '30609' diagnosed with. List all the date of laboratory tests done for this patient.
trace.evidence: '30609' is the Patient ID; disease means Diagnosis

attempts.sql:
SELECT p.Diagnosis, l.Date
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 30609

trace.final_sql:
SELECT p.Diagnosis, l.Date
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 30609
trace.answer: Patient 30609 is diagnosed with SLE and MCTD. The laboratory test dates run from July 12, 1984 onward, with 60 dates in total; the first 20 are shown above, ranging from July 12, 1984 to December 12, 1985.
